projects.title: PARENA
bullets: Built a C automation project with Makefile and Shell scripts, wiring continuous integration and an automated test suite across nearly 500 files.
After an intermittent CI failure took a day to trace, added structured logging around the build steps that finally made the failure reproducible.

projects.title: EMILY
bullets: Developed a Go-based service for handling background workloads, adding CI and an automated test suite so teammates could confirm changes did not break other workflows.

leadership.title: Peer Reviewer
bullets: Reviewed classmates' bug reports for a systems course and noticed missing reproduction steps, then proposed a short checklist covering environment, sequence, and expected behavior.
Paired with a teammate confused by a flaky test suite, walking through log output together until the root cause, a shared test fixture, became clear.
